exposure: potential cesarean delivery for fetal benefit
outcome: Frequency of patients desiring potential CD for fetal benefit
cohort: Singleton pregnancies delivering between 23(0/7) and 25(6/7) weeks at a tertiary care center from 2015 to 2020
finding: While a majority of patients delivering between 23(0/7) and 25(6/7) weeks desired monitoring and potential CD for fetal benefit, this varied significantly by gestational age.
mod_finding: The decision to perform monitoring and potential CD for fetal benefit was associated with a high frequency of CD, while the decision to forgo monitoring was associated with high frequency of intrapartum demise.
